The Captain's dead. So are half the security detail.''"
"''How many targets are there?''"
"''Two, but they've split up.|An officer and Jensen Corbyt|audio=Officer-Corbyt-Ahsoka1.flac|{{Ahsoka|Part One: Master and Apprentice}}}} '''Jensen Corbyt''' was a [[human]] who served as a [[lieutenant]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet]], holding the [[Assignment|position]] of [[Executive officer|First Officer]] under [[Captain]] [[Hayle]] on board the [[Defender-class cruiser|''Defender''-class cruiser]] ''[[Vesper]]''. While the [[cruiser]] was [[transport]]ing the [[prisoner]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]], it was approached by a [[Baylan's shuttle|vessel]] supposedly carrying two [[Jedi]] in [[Sector G-38]]. Hayle gave Corbyt [[Commanding officer|command]] of the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] as he went to meet the new arrivals, who were in fact [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces|allies]] of Elsbeth. After her ally [[Baylan Skoll]] [[Death|killed]] Hayle, the [[Force-sensitive]] [[Shin Hati]] [[Attack on the Vesper|fought]] her way to the bridge and killed Corbyt. ==Biography== ===Unexpected arrivals=== {{Quote|A ship has entered this sector.''"
"''They're early.''"
"''It isn't ''Home One''.|A nav droid and Jensen Corbyt|audio=NavDroid-Corbyt-Ahsoka1.flac|}} [[File:CorbytAndHayle-Ahsoka1.png|thumb|left|300px|Jensen Corbyt served with Captain Hayle on the ''Vesper''.]] Jensen Corbyt was a [[human]] who served as an [[New Republic officer|officer]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet|Defense Fleet]] of the [[New Republic]]. In [[9 ABY]], she held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] and was stationed on board the [[Defender-class cruiser|''Defender''-class cruiser]] ''[[Vesper]]'' as [[Executive officer|First Officer]], serving under [[Captain]] [[Hayle]] and assuming commmand whenever his duties took him off the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. Most of the [[Starship|vessel's]] crew had extensive combat experience, having distinguished themselves during the [[Galactic Civil War]].{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|99|History of the Ship}} After being [[Liberation of Calodan|captured]] by the [[Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], the former [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] was brought on board the ''Vesper'' as a [[prisoner]] for [[transport]] to her trial by the New Republic. Corbyt stood on board the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] with Hayle as the [[cruiser]] entered [[sector G-38]], where it was planned to meet with the New Republic [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser|vessel]] ''[[Home One]]''. After a [[Unidentified New Republic nav droid|nav droid]] informed the [[officer]]s that another [[Baylan's shuttle|ship]] had entered the [[sector]], Corbyt assumed it was the ''Home One'' arriving earlier than expected, but the [[droid]] informed her that it was a different [[Eta-class shuttle|vessel]]. Hayle then announced a security alert and had a [[Unidentified New Republic comm officer|comms officer]] contact the unidentified [[Shuttle|vessel]] to request identification and clearance codes. ===Killed in the line of duty=== {{Quote|I'm calling their bluff. Signal them to come aboard. I want to meet these "Jedi." Have security meet me in the hangar. You've got the bridge.''"
"''Yes, sir|Hayle and Corbyt|audio=Hayle-Corbyt-Ahsoka1.flac|}} The vessel sent back an old Jedi clearance code, which surprised Corbyt, but Hayle agreed to let the new arrivals on board to meet the prisoner, hoping to call their bluff and reveal their true identity. The captain then got up to go and greet them and ordered Corbyt to have the cruiser's security meet him in the [[hangar]], giving her [[Commanding officer|command]] of the bridge while he was gone. Corbyt then took a seat in the captain's chair. [[File:CorbytAndHati-Ahsoka1.png|thumb|right|300px|Jensen Corbyt was killed by Shin Hati.]] The "Jedi" in the hangar were in fact [[Baylan Skoll]] and [[Shin Hati]], [[Force-sensitive]] [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces|allies]] of Elsbeth. They quickly [[Attack on the Vesper|cut down]] Hayle and the security detail in the hangar, causing alarms to begin sounding on the bridge. Corbyt began trying to enact defensive protocols and was handed a [[blaster pistol]] by a crew member as she received a report on Hayle's [[death]], learning that the attackers had split up. The First Officer then spun in her chair as Hati entered the bridge, [[Shin Hati's lightsaber|lightsaber]] drawn, which she used to [[Lightsaber combat|deflect]] a series of shots from Corbyt's [[blaster]] while advancing on the officer. The Force-sensitive then killed Corbyt and everyone else on the bridge before scuttling the ship and leaving with Skoll and Elsbeth. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|They're Jedi.''"
"''Say again?''"
"''The signal is an old Jedi clearance code. They say they're here to see the prisoner.''"
"''Captain, who are they?|The comms officer and Jensen Corbyt|audio=CommsOfficer-Corbyt-Ahsoka1.flac|}} Corbyt was surprised at the mention of Jedi but remained stoically at her post even under dire circumstances. She had [[Color|tan]] skin, black [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. The lieutenant stood 1.68 [[meter]]s tall. ==Equipment== Jensen Corbyt wore a brown and blue [[New Republic officers' dress uniform|New Republic officer's uniform]] with a [[Rebel command insignia|rank insignia plaque]] showing one blue dot. When the ship was attacked, she was armed with a blaster [[pistol]]. ==Behind the scenes== Jensen Corbyt was portrayed by [[Shakira Barrera]] in "[[Part One: Master and Apprentice]]," the first episode in the [[Ahsoka Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'', which aired on [[August 22]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/ahsoka-new-premiere-date|text=''Ahsoka'' Premiere Moves Up to Tuesday, August 22}} Prior to the episode's release, Corbyt was first revealed in a teaser trailer for the series released on [[April 7]] of the same year.{{SWYouTube|HnzNZ0Mdx4I|Ahsoka | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/ahsoka-teaser-trailer}} The character's name was then revealed by official promotional assets linked to the show released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Walt Disney Studios]] via [[Wikipedia:Getty Images|Getty Images]] on [[August 15]], 2023.{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess#!asset/vnm39j474kmhgmmcg849xk3|text=The Walt Disney Studios All Access -
